moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

moves.name: Parting Shot
moves.description:
Dark (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If this move is successful, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if the target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages were both unchanged, or if there are no unfainted party members.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.description:
Fairy (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 95
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 1
Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description:
Dark (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

items.name: Light Clay
items.description: Holder's use of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, or Reflect lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Roseli Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fairy-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Babiri Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Steel-type attack. Single use.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.description: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.
